title: azure.yaml with the x-foundry extension
description: Validates the x-foundry key of an azure.yaml while allowing every native azd property alongside it. Combine with the native azure.yaml schema in editors (allOf). x-foundry is implemented by a custom extension and is not a native azure.yaml capability.

xFoundry.description: Root configuration for the custom x-foundry extension.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the x-foundry schema used by this document.

projects.description: Foundry projects this configuration applies to. The projects themselves are created by azd (azure.ai.project services); use the same names here.

topology.description: Defines whether projects are independent or inherit shared configuration from a hub.

mode.description: standalone creates independently configured projects. hub-spoke enables a shared hub and inheritance.

defaults.description: Default values applied to resources unless overridden by a project or component.

namingPrefix.description: Prefix used for generated Azure resource names.

environment.description: Environment profile. dev has no recommendations. test adds security, operations and cost recommendations. prod adds the Azure Well-Architected recommendations for reliability, security, operations and cost. Recommendations are warnings; they never block a deployment.

security.description: Intent-based security policy translated into RBAC, network, firewall, gateway and private connectivity resources.

localAuthentication.description: Whether local or key-based authentication is permitted on supported resources.

publicNetworkAccess.description: Global public-network intent. Component-level settings may restrict access further.

purgeProtection.description: Default purge-protection setting for supported resources such as Key Vault.

networkSecurity.description: High-level network intent. Without any network settings no VNet is created and endpoints are public (Entra ID authentication only). Specifying a VNet makes the deployment private: the extension then generates the VNet, subnets, private endpoints and DNS configuration.

mode.description: public: no VNet is created. restricted: public endpoints limited to allowedIps. private: a VNet, private endpoints and private DNS. When omitted, the mode is private if any VNet setting is present (addressSpace, agentSubnetPrefixLength or an existing VNet/subnet ID) and public otherwise.

allowedDomains.description: Permitted user email or token domains. This is an identity policy and does not create network DNS filtering.

allowedIps.description: Permitted IPv4, IPv6 or CIDR ranges.

privateDns.description: Whether the extension manages private DNS zones and VNet links.

existingVnetResourceId.description: Optional resource ID of an existing VNet. If omitted in private mode, the extension generates a VNet.

addressSpace.description: CIDR block (/16 to /22, private range) for the VNet the extension generates. Choose a range that does not overlap on-premises or peered networks. Defaults to 10.20.0.0/16.

agentSubnetPrefixLength.description: Prefix length of the generated agent subnet, delegated to Microsoft.App/environments for the Foundry Agent Service. Foundry requires /27 or larger; /24 is recommended.

existingAgentSubnetResourceId.description: Existing subnet delegated to Microsoft.App/environments for the Foundry Agent Service. Required with existingVnetResourceId when the standard agent setup is used.

existingPrivateEndpointSubnetResourceId.description: Existing subnet that hosts private endpoints. Required with existingVnetResourceId in private mode.

securityRoles.description: Logical Entra principal assignments. Values may be Entra group display names or object IDs.

projectRoles.description: Project-scoped principal assignments, added to the roles in security.roles.

principalList.description: Entra users, groups, service principals or managed identities.

oneOf.description: Entra group display name or object ID.

hub.description: Shared configuration. Valid only when topology.mode is hub-spoke.

inheritance.description: Controls which hub resources are inherited by spoke projects.

project.description: A Foundry project and its project-specific configuration.

inheritHub.description: Whether this project inherits resources from the configured hub. Defaults to true when a hub exists.

modelConfiguration.description: Model governance: which models are allowed and denied. Model deployments are declared on the azd azure.ai.project service, not here.

default.description: Name of the default model deployment (declared on the azd azure.ai.project service).

foundryIQ.description: Foundry IQ knowledge-base, source, indexing, retrieval and routing configuration.

connection.description: Name of an azd azure.ai.connection service (or an existing project connection); x-foundry does not create connections.

indexConfiguration.description: Search index, field, chunking, vector and semantic-ranking configuration.

deployment.description: Name of the embedding model deployment declared on the azd azure.ai.project service.

filterClaims.description: Maps token claims to filterable index fields.

gateway.description: APIM AI Gateway configuration generated by the custom extension.

projectGateway.description: Project-specific registration with the shared APIM AI Gateway.

target.description: Logical agent, model, Search or knowledge base target.

type.description: Identity attached to extension-created gateway and Search resources. Foundry accounts and projects always use a system-assigned identity, which the platform requires.

defenderPlans.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud plans to enable on the subscription.

ipRange.description: IPv4 address, IPv6 address or CIDR range.

cosmos.description: Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL account that stores Foundry Agent Service threads and agent state in the standard agent setup. Created implicitly when the standard setup is used.

throughput.description: Total RU/s for provisioned capacity. The standard agent setup needs at least 3000 RU/s (1000 per container).

agentService.description: How the Foundry Agent Service stores state and reaches networks.

setup.description: basic uses Microsoft-managed storage. standard brings your own Storage, AI Search and Cosmos DB, and in private mode injects the agent subnet. auto selects standard in private mode or when cosmos is configured, otherwise basic.
